title: S6 adversarial design panel — one persona's verdict
description: architecture.md S6: 'Findings are categorized verdicts, not prose.' One document per persona per review pass; S6 runs one or more personas against the current draft design (whatever S4 design fragments exist) and merges their verdicts.

overall.description: pass: no findings at error severity. pass_with_findings: only warning-severity findings. fail: at least one error-severity finding -- architecture.md: 'Design iterates S4->S6 until pass.'

findings.description: Empty array is a valid, meaningful result (nothing wrong found), not omitted.

category.description: Persona-specific category, e.g. 'sampling_policy', 'cardinality', 'collector_failure_mode' for cost_skeptic/SRE; 'injection_surface', 'data_flow' for security

gate.description: Short stable identifier for this specific check, e.g. cs-sampling-not-percentile-sized

evidence.description: What in the design (signal names, surface point IDs) grounds this finding -- a categorized verdict traces to something concrete, not a vibe
